description: This file contains unit tests for the RuntimeLocator component, which appears to resolve and verify the Node runtime version on macOS systems. The tests cover successful resolution, failure modes due to unsupported or unparsable versions, and version parsing logic.

classes.name: RuntimeLocatorTests
classes.description: A struct containing unit test functions for testing RuntimeLocator resolution and parsing logic.

methods.name: makeTempExecutable
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory and file containing the specified script contents, sets executable permissions, and returns the file URL.

methods.name: `resolve succeeds with valid node`
methods.description: Test that resolution succeeds when a valid Node executable with a supported version is present.

methods.name: `resolve fails on boundary below minimum`
methods.description: Test that resolution fails with an unsupported error when the Node version is below the minimum supported version.

methods.name: `resolve fails when too old`
methods.description: Test that resolution fails with an unsupported error when the Node version is too old.

methods.name: `resolve fails when version unparsable`
methods.description: Test that resolution fails with a versionParse error when the version string cannot be parsed.

methods.name: `describe failure includes paths`
methods.description: Checks that the failure message includes the searched paths and relevant version info.

methods.name: `runtime version parses with leading V and metadata`
methods.description: Verifies that the RuntimeVersion.from(string:) method correctly parses versions with leading 'v' and metadata suffixes.
